items.title: Changement CoA du 2026/08/04
items.summary: [Pending Restart] [Chronomancer] Epic Recovery reworked slightly. Now triggers the max known rank of Epoch at 50% efficiency, up from rank 1, but only affects 2 additional targets, down from 5. Additionally, the additional Epochs triggered by Epic Recovery can now trigger all Aeons. Developers Note: The goal here is that by allowing it to trigger at max rank as well as trigger aeons, this gives an easier time keeping up those bonuses, as well as allowing for an easier time spreading Accelerated Recovery. In line with the goal above of reducing blanket coverage at the push of a single button, target count has gone down and it triggers with reduced efficiency. The reduced efficiency trigger will still be a larger heal than the rank 1 version would be, as it gains proper SP coefficients.
